questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "turnover" mean?
options: The interest rate set by the central bank
The number of companies listed on the exchange
The profit earned by a company
The total amount of money traded in the market
questions.explain_en: Turnover refers to the total value of shares that were bought and sold during the session.
questions.explain_zh: 「turnover」指的是當日成交的總金額，即買賣股票的總金額。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX eases before Mid-Autumn break as heavyweights soften

questions.question: According to the summary, why do institutions expect the medium-term uptrend to continue?
options: Because the TAIEX index rose by more than 1%
Because the four major U.S. indices are gaining
Because Hon Hai's stock price increased sharply
Because of AI demand, high export orders, and TSMC's upcoming earnings call
questions.explain_en: The summary states institutions see AI demand, strong export orders, and TSMC's mid‑October earnings call as supporting factors.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到，機構認為 AI 需求、出口訂單強勁以及台積電十月中旬的財報說明會是支撐中期上升趨勢的因素。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX eases before Mid-Autumn break as heavyweights soften

questions.question: According to the summary, when are investors expected to pay more attention to the 2nm ramp and related suppliers?
questions.explain_en: The summary says investors will focus on the 2nm ramp in the fourth quarter.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到投資者將在第四季關注 2nm 產能提升及相關供應商。
questions.news_title_en: Qualcomm flagship chips on TSMC 2nm keep advanced-node chain in focus

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "clear" mean when it says "life insurers should clear the 100% statutory qualifying line"?
options: to meet or pass the requirement
questions.explain_en: Here "clear" means to meet or pass the required level.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「clear」指的是達到或通過規定的標準。
questions.news_title_en: Life insurers on track to clear first TIS solvency test

questions.question: According to the summary, when is the first half-year filing for the new TIS regime due?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the first half-year filing is due this month.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明上半年的申報本月到期。
questions.news_title_en: Life insurers on track to clear first TIS solvency test

questions.question: In the summary, what does the term "concentration‑risk" mean?
options: The danger of holding too much of one stock
The risk of a market crash
questions.explain_en: Concentration‑risk is the danger that a portfolio is overly weighted in a single company, so a bad move by that company hurts the whole portfolio.
questions.explain_zh: 集中風險指的是投資組合過度集中在單一公司，若該公司表現不佳，整體資產會受較大衝擊。
questions.news_title_en: FSC raises single-stock cap for equity funds and active ETFs to 25%

questions.question: Before the regulator's change, what was the maximum percentage of net asset value that a domestic equity fund could hold in a single listed company?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the rule previously barred holdings of more than 10% of NAV in a single company.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，原本規定單一公司持股上限為淨資產價值的10%。
questions.news_title_en: FSC raises single-stock cap for equity funds and active ETFs to 25%

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "buoyant" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "buoyant" describes equity turnover that is strong and active, not sad or slow.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「buoyant」指的是股市成交活絡、強勁，而不是悲觀或下降。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan tax take tops NT$3tn in first eight months, a record

questions.question: By how much did the cumulative tax revenue from January to August increase compared to the previous year?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the January‑August cumulative haul was up 25.2% year on year.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，1 月至 8 月的累計稅收較去年增加了 25.2%。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan tax take tops NT$3tn in first eight months, a record

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "higher-for-longer" mean?
options: Interest rates will stay high for an extended period
Interest rates will be lowered soon
questions.explain_en: "Higher-for-longer" describes a policy where rates remain elevated for a longer time to combat inflation.
questions.explain_zh: 「higher-for-longer」指的是為了抑制通膨，利率會長時間維持在較高水平。
questions.news_title_en: Fed hikes in September and signals another move before year-end

questions.question: How many Federal Reserve officials expect at least one more rate hike in 2026?
questions.explain_en: The summary says 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike in 2026.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中指出 18 位官員中有 16 位預期 2026 年至少再加息一次。
questions.news_title_en: Fed hikes in September and signals another move before year-end
